scientific_integrity: An explicit Euclidean edge-length certificate gives the global upper bound; independent Laplacian spectral blocks attain it. Finite numerical replay is supplementary and does not certify all graph sizes. Novelty remains subject to further specialized-literature scrutiny.
scientific_limitations: Undirected unit-mass continuous-time Laplacians, nonnegative edge rates, one leaf at each of two distinct clique vertices; does not claim uniqueness of all optimizer vectors or coverage of arbitrary stationary measures. Root defined implicitly; only finite numerical checks are reported in addition to a complete analytic proof.
title: Exact spectral-gap allocation for a clique with two leaves at distinct vertices
